Rank projection: remaining quals simulated with team strengths drawn once per simulated event; RP = 3 win / 1 tie + ENERGIZED (>=100 FUEL) + SUPERCHARGED (>=360 FUEL) + TRAVERSAL (>=50 tower pts); TBA tiebreakers avg match pts (no fouls), avg auto FUEL, avg tower pts.
Defence gains assume ~70% engagement during the target's active shifts; rate retained is measured only where the target has been defended on video (basis field).
Not modelled in the simulator: defence/congestion interactions, per-team fouls.
